parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue of mask propagation in NDDataRef by ensuring that None masks are handled correctly. The change is minimal and focused.

issues.description: The patch introduces a minor maintainability/readability defect by adding an unnecessary else clause. The code can be simplified by directly assigning the value to self._mask without the else.
